## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project (Biome)
- [ ] I have run `pnpm lint` and `pnpm typecheck` and they pass
- [ ] I have run `pnpm test` and all tests pass
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or my feature works
- [ ] I have added/updated fixtures if my change affects rule behavior
- [ ] I have updated the golden scores in `packages/fixtures/golden/` if scores changed
- [ ] I have run `pnpm check-score-stability` and confirmed any score drift is intentional
- [ ] I have updated the documentation accordingly (README, docs/rules/*.md, etc.)
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings
- [ ] I have added a changelog entry in `CHANGELOG.md` (under `[Unreleased]`)
